title: Reference lists and external links are extracted as article prose
acceptance: A citation list, Notes list, Further reading and External links section are not part of the extracted article body
wikipedia_readability and wikipedia_epub both exclude their backmatter, and BOTH frozen expectations are updated together to reflect it
The rule keys on something structural — MediaWiki's Cite markup, a backmatter heading, or list shape — not on the page
Real prose that happens to be list-shaped is still extracted; apache_license and python_docs_tutorial do not regress
The word-count drop for both Wikipedia fixtures is stated in the commit message so the change is auditable
notes: EXPLICIT AUTHORITY TO EDIT TWO FROZEN EXPECTATIONS, granted by the overseer: wikipedia_epub.json and wikipedia_readability.json. This is the rare case where the expectation itself encodes the defect. wikipedia_epub was frozen at T-0006 because the page extracted completely, and nobody asked whether a 69-item citation list belongs in a reading view; it does not. The normal rule stands everywhere else — never edit a frozen expectation to make your own diff pass — and it stands here for every OTHER fixture. Found by T-0027's agent, which correctly refused to exclude references because doing so would have failed wikipedia_epub, and reported the tension rather than shipping a silent compromise. Backmatter is roughly 40-43% of raw text on both pages, so this is a large and very visible quality change for a reading app.
